/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/components | head -40 && rg -n \"function Select|const Select|Segmented\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g 'Select.d.ts' -g 'Segmented*.d.ts' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'

@@

+import {
+  createContext,
+  useContext,
+  useEffect,
+  useMemo,
+  useState,
+  type ReactNode,
+} from 'react';
@@
 export function I18nProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
   const [language, setLanguage] = useState<Language>('en');
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    document.documentElement.lang = language;
+  }, [language]);

@@
-<html lang=\"en\" data-app-language=\"en\">

*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
